elevenlabsPrompt:
[intrigued] Your iPhone has a hidden 80 percent charging limit.

[confident] Here's the fix. Set a charge limit.

[friendly] On iPhone 15 or newer, open Settings, then Battery. Tap Charging. Pick 80 percent.

[delighted] It stops at 80, so the battery wears out slower.

[warm] One tech tip a day, at techtipaday dot com.
